cd /code && python - <<'PY'
import nbformat, os
from nbconvert.preprocessors import ExecutePreprocessor
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris

nb = nbformat.read('FGBR_OC.ipynb', as_version=4)
patch = nbformat.v4.new_code_cell("""
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
import pandas as pd

def _local_load_dataset(name, sep=','):
    if name == 'iris':
        data = load_iris(as_frame=True)
        df = data.frame.copy()
        df = df.rename(columns={'sepal length (cm)':'sepal_length','sepal width (cm)':'sepal_width','petal length (cm)':'petal_length','petal width (cm)':'petal_width'})
        df['species'] = data.target.map(dict(enumerate(data.target_names)))
        return df[['sepal_length','sepal_width','petal_length','petal_width','species']]
    raise RuntimeError(f'Unsupported dataset {name}')

sns.load_dataset = _local_load_dataset
""")
nb.cells.insert(0, patch)

ep = ExecutePreprocessor(timeout=-1, kernel_name='python3', allow_errors=True)
ep.preprocess(nb, {'metadata': {'path': '/code'}})
with open('/results/FGBR_OC_executed.ipynb', 'w') as f:
    nbformat.write(nb, f)
body, _ = HTMLExporter().from_notebook_node(nb)
Path('/results/FGBR_OC.html').write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
print('done')
